clue.text: Not a billion breaking stones put in the boot

parts.note: not a thing is nothing, the zero-shaped letter O

explanation.surface: Someone smashes stones in a boot, refusing to do it for any billion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not a' gives O (nought, not a thing) and 'billion' gives BN; together they break into HAIL.
explanation.definitionFit: A hobnail is a heavy-headed nail hammered into the sole of a boot, so it is something put in the boot.

clue.text: Seek to dispose of bird

a bird of prey such as a goshawk

explanation.definitionFit: Hawking is offering goods for sale in the street, and the hawk is also a familiar raptor.

explanation.walkthrough: 19 is SPA, so the definition is a spa town: BATH, in Somerset, famous for its Roman baths.
explanation.definitionFit: Bath is the best known English spa town, so it is an example of entry 19.

clue.text: Landing place exposes journey

clue.text: Tell performing well

explanation.definitionFit: Strathpeffer in the Scottish Highlands grew up around its sulphur springs as a spa resort, an instance of entry 19.

clue.text: G-girl teacher in old see-through vehicle

clue.text: Two girls heard from the Lizard?
